content:
Noah Kim: hey everyone, first-day setup question: trying to access Admin panels in Console (staging) to review FF rollout metrics but getting a 403. I have the Console tile in Okta but clicking it just shows the Console homepage and the Admin link is missing. who should I ask to get admin visibility?
Tara - IT: @Noah Kim welcome! sounds like you only have the staging:console-viewer role. Admin panels require staging:console-admin. Please request a JIT via https://access.redwood.ai/jit and add your manager Jordan Rivers. If the JIT is slow, @Riley (Platform) can run an owner lookup and give temporary scoped access.
Noah Kim: tried the JIT but it errored out for me (500).
OncallBot: Incident INC-2026-45 detected: JIT service returned 500 for new access requests. On-call: Tara - IT.
Riley (Platform): @Tara can you accept an emergency approval? I can create a scoped token for 20 mins to let Noah see the admin metrics.
Tara - IT: approved, sending a short session.
OncallBot: Emergency approval applied by Tara - IT. Session ID: SESS-9912.
Noah Kim: can see the Admin panels now, thanks! a note: the rollout metrics page is super helpful but the graphs are a bit slow; maybe smaller time windows default?
Jordan Rivers: thanks for the quick help everyone. Noah, ping me after you poke around and i'll add the proper groups in Okta if you need long-term access.
Riley (Platform): follow-up: created a ticket for JIT 500s (TCK-441) and will patch the error page text to include the manual approval contact while we fix it.
Noah Kim: will do. also thumbs up to the onboarding team for making the console nav easy to find.
